significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(ii) causal conclusion that, for many jailbreaks, a distinct linearly readable safety-verdict-uncertainty component is collapsed while harmfulness belief remains high, and that selectively restoring this component causes refusal to return. This establishes both a cross-attack behavioral phenomenon (false-confidence collapse) and a three-way causal decomposition of harmfulness belief, refusal action, and verdict confidence; that decomposition would materially constrain explanations built around refusal mediation, such as Arditi et al., “Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction” (2024), and would predict which intervention should affect compliance without changing harmfulness belief. Verified false, especially failure of separability or causal transfer, would rule out this specific linear metacognitive pathway rather than uncertainty mechanisms generally, so the branches are distinguishable and informative but not field-settling. The topic-substitution check lowers no score: replacing the specific claim with generic “mechanistic LLM safety” would lose the independently manipulable third pathway and leave only a topic-level hypothesis worth about 5.

reach.justification: The named handles are the measurable “verdict-uncertainty” projection and “Verdict-Uncertainty Re-injection (VUR),” which “flags abnormally-collapsed verdict uncertainty” and applies an activation nudge; this is ex ante or mid-inference because it can intervene before harmful compliance is generated, rather than merely explaining a completed failure. Although the direction and gain require per-model calibration, the asserted relation survives re-extraction: successful attacks should show low verdict uncertainty while harmfulness belief remains high, and restoring uncertainty should recover refusal across aligned LLMs and attack families. The immediate downstream users are researchers, auditors, and deployment engineers with activation access, while closed-model users and fields outside AI receive no direct handle; adaptive co-suppression also limits universality. The topic-substitution check passes: generic interpretability for safety supplies neither this gated predictor nor this inference-time action window, so the reach comes from the claim rather than the topic.
